title: The Azure Blue Christmas Eve Soup Night
description: A Christmas Eve soup night, all from Sam's Club: an azure Le Creuset Signature oval Dutch oven, Member's Mark teal toile dinnerware, green wavy edge bakeware, candy cane kitchen towels, Balsam and Pine carousel candles and marble and acacia boards.
intro: Christmas Eve doesn't need a big fancy dinner. It needs one giant pot of soup, a loaf of crusty bread, roasted veggies and everybody in pajamas by six. The trick is making it feel like an occasion without cooking all day: a blue Dutch oven on the island, pretty toile bowls, candles spinning, candy cane towels everywhere. These are the pieces picked for that night. Low effort, big cozy.

sections.heading: The cooking pieces
paragraphs: The Le Creuset Signature Oval Dutch Oven in Azure, 5 quart, enameled cast iron with a light interior. The Member's Mark 3-Piece Wavy Edge Bakeware in Green, three nesting stoneware dishes with handles, for the roasted vegetables.

sections.heading: The table
paragraphs: The Member's Mark 12-Piece Porcelain Toile Dinnerware Set in Teal, service for 4. The Member's Mark Marble and Acacia Wood Charcuterie Boards, Set of 2, for the bread and cheese. The Member's Mark Holiday Kitchen Towel Set, 6-Pack, in Candy Cane. And the Member's Mark Carousel Candle, Set of 2, in Balsam and Pine, 14 ounces each, with little carousels that spin when they're lit.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The kitchen, the soup, the bread, the mugs, the garland and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, color and size before you buy.
